title: Canvas Common Rules
description: Workspace-wide rules the agent applies and verifies before every canvas change.

rules.title: Separate canvas and frame input ownership
rules.statement: In board and comment mode the canvas owns pan/zoom; in run mode the HTML frame owns scroll, hover, click and keyboard input.
rules.rationale: Keeps canvas navigation and real screen interaction from stealing each other's input.

checks: In comment mode, a trackpad wheel over a frame pans the canvas.
In comment mode, a pointer drag on a frame creates a region comment.
In run mode, scroll, hover and click work inside the frame.

rules.title: Show state changes as a separate outcome frame
rules.statement: When a user action changes screen state, build the result as its own frame and surface it with a connection and a highlight.
rules.rationale: Lets a static design review still trace cause and effect.

checks: Every state-changing action has an outcome frame.
A connection is defined between the action and its outcome frame.
The outcome frame is highlighted after the action runs.

rules.title: Route connections orthogonally from action ports
rules.statement: Connections start at a top/right/bottom/left port of an action such as a button and run to a port on the outcome frame along an orthogonal gutter route that never crosses another frame.
rules.rationale: Makes the origin of each flow explicit and avoids ambiguous lines cutting across the canvas.

checks: Connection route.from references a real action and a top/right/bottom/left port.
No connection cuts through the inside of an unrelated frame.
Overlapping reverse connections use separate lanes.

rules.title: Link planning notes as cards around the frame
rules.statement: Planning notes are never collapsed into comment pins; place them as cards around the frame in planning notes mode and link them to their target item with a numbered anchor and a link line.
rules.rationale: Keeps policy and planning explanations out of review feedback while showing the context at a glance.

checks: In planning notes mode the card shows the note title, kind, text and ID.
Selecting the target item, the numbered anchor or the note card highlights all of them together.
Planning notes and comments do not share a lifecycle or a marker.

rules.title: Separate comment status from revision status
rules.statement: Manage the comment workflow as open, discussion and resolved, kept separate from target revision state. Show agent comments that need review and hide comments the user already resolved by default.
rules.rationale: Prevents confusing a yellow needs-discussion comment with one that went stale because the screen changed.

checks: Open and discussion comments show as pins; resolved comments are excluded from the default view and the comment count.
Outdated uses a dashed revision marker distinct from the workflow colors.
The agent records a change summary and the current targetRevision on every resolved comment.

rules.title: Promote generalizable feedback to a rule only after approval
rules.statement: Rules the user states explicitly are recorded as active; rules the agent infers from comments are offered as proposed and become active only after the user approves them.
rules.rationale: Cuts repeated feedback without letting a one-off preference become a permanent constraint on every canvas.

checks: The agent distinguishes a one-off fix from a rule candidate that applies across canvases.
Inferred rules stay proposed until the user approves them.
Promoted rules keep the provenance of the original comment ID.

rules.title: Check library definitions before UI work
rules.statement: Before any UI/UX work the agent searches the existing foundation, layout, component and story contracts, and creates a new stable library target only when no suitable definition exists.
rules.rationale: Accumulates consistent definition data instead of rebuilding HTML and styles for every frame.

checks: libraryIndex was checked before working on the frame.
Reused components declare both libraryUses and data-ui.
No undefined prop, variant or state was invented.

rules.title: Never edit generated HTML as source
rules.statement: The agent does not edit dist/canvas.html or read it as primary input; it edits only the data, fragment and style sources returned by the context router.
rules.rationale: Prevents duplicating the shared runtime or back-editing generated output, keeping the next render reproducible.

checks: The work started from a stable target ID and context.mjs.
No changed file is the generated dist/canvas.html.
Re-running update.mjs reproduces the same output.
